walk.locationDisclosureBody:
This app collects location data while the app is closed or not in use (in the background) to record your walk route accurately.

Location is used only to draw maps and calculate distance. It is not used for ads or shared with third parties.
walk.locationDisclosureAlwaysHint: On the next screen, choose "Always Allow".

settings.faqIntro: Frequently asked questions about Annie Walking Log.

family.q: How do I share records with family?
family.a: From Settings, use "Invite family" to send your family code. They install the app, sign up, and enter the same code.

guest.a: Try the app without signing up. Limits: last 10 walks, 1 pet, no photos. If you log out, you lose access to your data. We recommend free registration to keep your records.

plans.q: What's the difference between Free and Premium?
plans.aIntro: Main differences between Free and Premium (Guest is a trial: 10 walks, 1 pet, no photos). After Premium ends, pet data stays on file, but Free limits apply (walks, list, and history filters: only the first 2 pets in your list order).

walk.a: Start a walk from the Walk tab. Route, distance, and time are saved to the cloud. Location permission is required.

graph.a: The comparison graph at the bottom is Premium only. The top graph uses records for your plan (Guest: last 10 walks, Free: last year). Subscribe via Settings → Premium plan through the App Store or Google Play.

premium.aIntro: If one family member subscribes, everyone with the same family code gets Premium. Pricing follows the App Store / Google Play listing (approx. ¥180/month or ¥1,800/year). Purchase or restore from Settings → Premium plan.
premium.aDowngrade: [After Premium ends] If you had 3+ pets registered, only the first 2 in list order stay usable on Free. Others are grayed out in the pet list (no reordering), walks allow 2 pets max, and history/graph pet filters match. Pet records are not deleted. Reorder the list to bring a pet into the top slots to use it again.
premium.aNote: For testing, set premiumExpiresAt on the families document in Firestore to a future timestamp. Set it in the past to simulate Free plan behavior.
